entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: DRAGONs eliminated.#nWhew...
entries.context: Naomi reports the hunt finished, then exhales with relief.
entries.decisions: The report retains military ellipsis; this is not an unidentified actor.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: Good work, everyone. You did well.#nLet's return to Arzenal.
entries.context: Salia praises the squadron after Naomi's completion report.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: (Now the Festa won't be canceled, right?#nI'm glad I could keep everyone smiling...)
entries.context: Naomi privately hopes the Festa can go ahead; she addresses nobody aloud.
entries.decisions: Private thought kept in parentheses; Festa is the established glossary name.

entries.speaker: Jill
entries.en: You said you saw a Rosenblum transport on the way?#nWhat happened to it?
entries.context: Jill questions Salia about the transport mentioned in the preceding scene.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: It broke through the DRAGON encirclement and escaped to the north-northeast.
entries.context: Salia gives Jill a formal report on the transport's escape.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: It's already beyond our radar's range,#nso I believe it's safe...
entries.context: Salia cautiously assesses the transport's safety for Jill.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Jill
entries.en: I see...
entries.context: Jill acknowledges Salia's report, withholding the reason for concern.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Did something happen?
entries.context: Naomi asks Jill about that concern.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Jill
entries.en: I'll explain the situation when you get back.#nReturn to Arzenal first.
entries.context: Jill defers Naomi's question and orders the squadron home.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Jill
entries.en: Good work.
entries.context: Jill closes the radio exchange by acknowledging their work.
entries.decisions: Conventional acknowledgment fragment retained intentionally, not compressed for length.

entries.speaker: Chris
entries.en: What's that about?
entries.context: Chris wonders about Jill's unexplained concern after the call.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: Who knows? Unless a stray shot brought it down,#nwe can't get in trouble for helping it, right?
entries.context: Rosalie reassures her companions that rescuing the transport should be harmless.
entries.decisions: Preserves the hypothetical stray-shot exception; does not claim the transport was shot down.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: You've got a point.
entries.context: Naomi agrees with Rosalie's reassurance.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: (Pleasantly tired and feeling accomplished,#nwe turn our Para-mails toward Arzenal.)
entries.context: Naomi narrates the squadron turning home, in present tense as in the source.
entries.decisions: Present narration preserved; identifies the group through preceding squadron exchange.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: (At the time, we still had no idea something so serious#nhad happened that it could make Inspector Emma faint—)
entries.context: Naomi's retrospective narration foreshadows a serious incident unknown to the squadron.
entries.decisions: Does not assert Emma actually fainted. Keeps the dramatic closing dash.

entries.speaker: Jill
entries.en: Keep the enemy away!#nDefend Arzenal to the last!
entries.context: New defense scene: Jill orders the defenders to keep enemies away from Arzenal.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Y-Yes, ma'am!
entries.context: Naomi nervously acknowledges Jill's defense order.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: Ange! Naomi!#nAre you all right?!
entries.context: New rescue scene: Tusk calls to Ange and Naomi amid the attack.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Tusk!#nWhat are you doing at Arzenal?!
entries.context: Naomi asks why Tusk is at Arzenal.
entries.decisions: Restores the omitted English question verb from the clearly identified addressee Tusk.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: I came to warn you about Julio's fleet attacking...#nWaaaaaah!
entries.context: Tusk explains his warning mission before danger makes him scream.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: Looks like I didn't make it in time!
entries.context: Tusk realizes the attacking fleet arrived before his warning.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: You're more than late—you're in the way!#nGet out of the battle zone, now!
entries.context: Ange angrily orders Tusk clear because he is obstructing the fight.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: Easy for you to say—waaah!!#nWith all this fighting, it's too—look out!!
entries.context: Tusk protests Ange's order, then interrupts himself as he dodges danger.
entries.decisions: Keeps the danger-induced interruption rather than completing Tusk's broken clause.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: Why did you even come here?!#nUgh!!
entries.context: Ange impatiently questions Tusk's purpose.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Vivian
entries.en: I can see him from here. Should I help him?#nOr shoot him down?
entries.context: Vivian asks whether to retrieve Tusk or shoot him down, teasingly.
entries.decisions: Tusk is the identified referent; male pronoun follows the researched character profile.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: Shoot him down.
entries.context: Ange curtly answers Vivian's teasing alternative.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: That's not funny!!#nAaah! My engine's been hit!! Help!!
entries.context: Tusk rejects the joke, reports engine damage, and begs for rescue.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Vivian, help him if you can.#nHe's a pervert, but he's not a bad person.
entries.context: Naomi asks Vivian to rescue Tusk, mixing reassurance with an insult.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Tusk
entries.en: That's harsh!#nThat was you, Naomi, wasn't it?!
entries.context: Tusk recognizes Naomi's voice and protests her insult.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Vivian
entries.en: Right, right! Picking up one pervert!
entries.context: Vivian announces Tusk's retrieval with a playful service-call cadence.
entries.decisions: Retrieval announcement kept playful; pervert insult retained.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: We're getting back to the fight.
entries.context: Ange redirects the group to the battle after the rescue exchange.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Right!
entries.context: Naomi acknowledges Ange's decision to resume fighting.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.context: Empty record with sentinel ID -1; no displayed language to translate.
entries.decisions: Preserve the empty sentinel exactly; it is excluded from completed translation counts.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: Naomi?!#nYou managed to sortie?
entries.context: New Embryo-aligned branch: Salia greets Naomi's successful sortie.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: B-Barely.
entries.context: Naomi answers Salia's question with a hesitant, elliptical admission.
entries.decisions: Deliberate elliptical reply retained; Salia's previous question supplies the proposition.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: I'm sending you the marker data.#nWe're getting out of here at full speed.
entries.context: Salia gives Naomi escape guidance and orders a rapid withdrawal.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Yes, ma'am!
entries.context: Naomi acknowledges Salia's withdrawal order.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Well, well. You're planning your escape route right here#non the First Squadron's shared channel?
entries.context: Hilda intercepts the shared radio traffic and mocks the escape planning.
entries.decisions: Restores the subject and verb from the intercepted radio conversation.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: Sorry, Naomi. Commander Jill ordered us#nnot to let you leave.
entries.context: Rosalie tells Naomi that Jill ordered them to block the escape.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Take my advice.#nSurrender.
entries.context: Hilda advises Naomi to surrender rather than resist.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: ...There's no way I can surrender.
entries.context: Naomi refuses Hilda's surrender demand.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Huh?
entries.context: Hilda reacts incredulously to Naomi's refusal.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: I chose Embryo over Commander Jill.#nBecause I thought that was the right choice.
entries.context: Naomi explains her decision to side with Embryo to Hilda and Rosalie.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: I just can't believe Commander Jill's Libertus#nis the right thing to do.
entries.context: Naomi rejects Jill's Libertus as a morally sound solution.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Even if we kill Embryo, humans and Norma#nwill just trade places.
entries.context: Naomi explains that killing Embryo would only invert the social hierarchy.
entries.decisions: Humans and Norma remain source social categories, without changing the contrast.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: And what's wrong with that?!#nWhat the hell are you complaining about?
entries.context: Rosalie forcefully challenges Naomi's objection to reversing the hierarchy.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Deep down, you know it too, Rosalie.#nA world like that is twisted.
entries.context: Naomi insists Rosalie knows that the proposed world would remain wrong.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: We didn't come all this way just to back down!#nYou think you can take us on, Naomi?!
entries.context: Rosalie refuses to retreat and challenges Naomi to fight them.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: I can't stay at Arzenal anymore.#nIf you won't move, I'll force my way through.
entries.context: Naomi says she cannot remain at Arzenal and will fight through the blockade.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: ...Tch. You really think we're pushovers!#nLet's go, Rosalie!!
entries.context: Hilda takes Naomi's threat as an insult and calls Rosalie into battle.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Damn it! Damn it!#nWe know where you're headed!
entries.context: Following battle segment: Hilda curses and warns that Naomi's destination is known.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Wait for us in the Empire of Misurugi. You're dead!
entries.context: Hilda threatens to pursue Naomi to the Empire of Misurugi and kill her.
entries.decisions: Neck-washing idiom rendered as a direct death threat, preserving its force.

entries.speaker: Embryo
entries.en: I'm sorry.#nI made you endure a painful fight.
entries.context: Embryo apologizes to Naomi for forcing a fight against former comrades.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: I was prepared for it. I just didn't think#nI'd have to fight them so soon.
entries.context: Naomi answers Embryo; she expected the conflict but not so soon.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Ersha
entries.en: We're leaving the airspace Arzenal controls.#nWe're safe now.
entries.context: Ersha reassures the escaping group as they leave Arzenal-controlled airspace.
entries.decisions: Airspace is controlled by Arzenal, not a place called Air Superiority.

entries.speaker: Embryo
entries.en: We'll continue on to the Empire of Misurugi.
entries.context: Embryo announces the escape group's destination.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Embryo
entries.en: Salia, Chris, Ersha.#nAnd Naomi.
entries.context: Embryo addresses each ally by name before thanking them in the next row.
entries.decisions: Vocative name list intentionally has no verb; thanks continues in the next source row.

entries.speaker: Embryo
entries.en: I'm grateful for your cooperation.#nThank you.
entries.context: Embryo thanks the allies he just named.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: You finally decided to show yourselves.
entries.context: New opposing route: Salia confronts Naomi's group; Naomi is now with Ange and Hilda.
entries.decisions: File boundary changes sides relative to the previous route; no allegiance carried across.

entries.speaker: Chris
entries.en: Tch. You're all still alive?#nI wish at least one of you had hit a depth charge.
entries.context: Chris cruelly complains that the approaching opponents survived the depth charges.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Let us through!
entries.context: Naomi demands passage through the opposing group's blockade.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Ersha
entries.en: No.#nWe can't let you go any farther.
entries.context: Ersha denies Naomi's request to proceed.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: How gullible can you idiots be?
entries.context: Ange insults the opponents' credulity toward Embryo.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Ange
entries.en: You've even put on matching rider suits,#nand you still believe Embryo's bullshit?
entries.context: Ange mocks their matching suits and continued belief in Embryo's claims.
entries.decisions: Strong insult preserved; rider suits follows the established glossary.

entries.speaker: Vivian
entries.en: The Radish Knights?#nSalia, your taste in names really sucks.
entries.context: Vivian mocks Salia's knightly organization with a vegetable-name pun.
entries.decisions: Daikon joke rendered as Radish Knights; the Japanese sound resemblance cannot be reproduced exactly.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: It's the Diamond Rose Knights!
entries.context: Salia angrily corrects Vivian's deliberate misnaming.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Vivian
entries.en: Wow, that one's even lamer!
entries.context: Vivian ridicules the corrected name even more.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: ...I'll kill every last one of you!
entries.context: Salia threatens to kill the entire opposing group.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Vivian
entries.en: Oops! Did I tick her off, meow?
entries.context: Vivian playfully comments on having provoked Salia.
entries.decisions: Playful catlike ending rendered as meow; referent is Salia established by the preceding threat.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: Ugh... Is fighting really our only choice?
entries.context: Naomi reluctantly asks whether the confrontation must turn violent.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Get your head in the fight!#nThey're the enemy!
entries.context: Hilda urges Naomi to accept that their former comrades are now enemies.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: Para-mail squad, split up in formation!#nWipe out the small fry scattering those depth charges!
entries.context: Hilda orders the Para-mail squad to disperse and eliminate depth-charge attackers.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Hilda
entries.en: We'll hold off the Ragna-mails!
entries.context: Hilda assigns her own group to contain the opposing Ragna-mails.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Naomi
entries.en: ...Yes, ma'am.
entries.context: Naomi reluctantly acknowledges Hilda's orders.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: Tch. You just won't die.#nChris! Ersha! We're using the Space-Time Convergence Cannon!
entries.context: Following battle segment: Salia orders Chris and Ersha to use their cannon.
entries.decisions: Wiki-backed Space-Time Convergence Cannon spelling; no byte-budget shortening.

entries.speaker: Ersha
entries.en: The Space-Time Convergence Cannon? It's still being tested,#nand Embryo said we mustn't use it—
entries.context: Ersha cites Embryo's prohibition on using the untested cannon; Salia cuts her off.
entries.decisions: Embryo's warning is interrupted by the following row. Preserve the explicit prohibition on using the cannon and the interruption dash; Japanese trails off in the attribution after naming Embryo.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: If you won't fire it, I'll do it myself!
entries.context: Salia interrupts Ersha's objection, threatening to fire alone.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Salia
entries.en: Aaaah?!
entries.context: Salia screams as Rosalie lands a hit, clarified by the following row.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Rosalie
entries.en: Bingo!#nYou're getting way too worked up, Salia!
entries.context: Rosalie celebrates the hit and taunts Salia for losing her composure.
entries.decisions: Full natural English; source row boundary and control order preserved; no byte-budget truncation.

entries.speaker: Chris
entries.en: Salia, let's head back for now. If we break our Ragna-mails,#nEmbryo will scold us.
entries.context: Chris urges Salia to withdraw, fearing Embryo's reprimand for damaging their machines.
entries.decisions: Familiar tone retained without a literal Japanese honorific; plural machines follows the group's Ragna-mails.
